dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing of the 2D silhouette from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Mainly smooth lateral margins with a subtle, low-amplitude convex protrusion on the right-hand margin relative to the central axis.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-dark grey slate tone, consistent with a juvenile or sub-adult pigmentation phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey patches distributed across the mid-dorsal and posterior regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; variations in grey-scale intensity occur over broad pixel gradients rather than sharp edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, horizontal, parallel linear markings (rake marks) crossing the dorsal midline in the posterior half of the visible body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of at least four distinct, parallel horizontal scars or rake marks visible on the lower dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible blowhole region accompanied by a circular cluster of white-pixel water turbulence and spray.
